b: Plan your visit · practical info - Everything to take the start. Registration, gear, race rules and your first triathlon: everything you need to know, for all three 2027 events. Registration Register for an event. Registration is online only, at lightontri.com, for Woippy**, Pierre-Percée*** or Madine***. Opens Tuesday, October 13, 2026 at 8:00 PM (Paris time) - the "Register" buttons stay disabled until then. Opens: Tuesday, October 13, 2026 at 8:00 PM (Paris time). 2027 prices L***: €119 (licence holder) / €134 (non-licence holder). M**: €59 / €69. S*: €34 / €39. Kids: €10. Licence & medical certificate Licence holders: triathlon licence to be uploaded on the registration platform. Non-licence holders: a medical certificate of no contraindication to competitive triathlon, less than a year old, to be submitted at least 15 days before the event. Bib collection The day before each race, from 17:00 to 19:00, or on race day depending on the event's schedule. Photo ID required. Changing your plans A bib transfer is possible up to 48h before the first collection slot (€3). A 50% refund on presentation of a medical certificate up to one month before the event, or a cancellation pack taken out at registration (€15 on L***, €10 on M**, not offered on S*). RegisterComing soon Read the full rules First triathlon Never done a triathlon ? Swimming, cycling and running on the same day: it sounds daunting before you try it, and it's simpler to prepare for than you'd think. Here's what you need for a calm start to your first LIGHT ON TRI. The transitions Between the swim and the bike, then between the bike and the run, you pass through your transition zone (bike park). Scout your spot and the flow of traffic before the start - that's where you save precious minutes, without the stress. The wetsuit Mandatory if the water is not above 16°C, recommended in all cases. The swim cap provided by the organiser, on the other hand, is always mandatory. Try your wetsuit in open water before the big day if it's your first time. The S* format, the right way in 500 m swim, 20 to 25 km bike, 5 km run: the S* format is designed for a first triathlon, with no time-limit pressure. Drafting and finer race rules: the 2027 rules don't yet detail these points - they'll be covered in each event's participant guide. Gear & race rules What to have on you. A written briefing is sent by email a few days before each event. In the meantime, the essentials of the 2027 rules. Bib & timing chip The bib provided must not be cut down or altered - only one is issued per participant. The timing chip is worn on the left ankle and must be returned after the finish, or a €50 charge applies. Bike A sticker provided by the organiser must be attached to your helmet and to the seat post of your bike. Swim The swim cap provided by the organiser is mandatory. A wetsuit is mandatory if the water is not above 16°C, recommended in all cases. Feed stations No outside feeding is allowed other than what's provided by the organiser. Environment Respect for the environment is required at all times on the course, under penalty of immediate sanction. Time limits L***: swim cut-off at 1h10, bike cut-off at 5h30. M**: bike cut-off at 3h00. S*: no time limit. FAQ Frequently asked questions. Do I need a licence to take part? Licence holders: your triathlon licence is to be uploaded on the registration platform. Non-licence holders: a medical certificate of no contraindication to competitive triathlon, less than a year old, to be submitted at least 15 days before the event. What's the minimum age to take part? S*: from the Cadet category upwards (born 2011 or earlier). M** and L***: from the Junior category upwards (born 2009 or earlier). Mini-Kids: born 2018, 2019, 2020 or 2021. Kids: born 2014, 2015, 2016 or 2017. How do I register? Online only, at lightontri.com - no on-the-day registration. 2027 registration opens Tuesday, October 13, 2026 at 8:00 PM (Paris time). I can no longer make it, what are my options? A bib transfer is possible up to 48h before the event's first bib collection slot (€3). On presentation of a medical certificate, 50% of the registration fee is refunded up to one month before the event. No refund within the last month, unless a cancellation pack was taken out at registration (€15 for L***, €10 for M**, not offered on S*). Full details in the rules. Do I need a wetsuit? It's mandatory if the water temperature is not above 16°C, and recommended in all cases. The swim cap provided by the organiser is always mandatory. Are there prizes? Yes, on L*** (€200/150/100 to the top 3 men and women) and M** (€100/75/50), plus the top 3 male and female veterans on each format. No prize on S*. Are there time limits? L***: swim cut-off at 1h10, bike cut-off at 5h30. M**: bike cut-off at 3h00. S*: no time limit. Another question? Write to us at hello@lightontri.com or call +33 6 37 08 97 57. We'll get back to you. A question before you register ? Write to us, we'll answer. Registration opens 13 October 2026. RegisterComing soon Write to us

Article 16 · Time limits after the start
b: 2027 Rules - The rules. LIGHT ON TRI event rules, last updated 07/10/2026. By registering, you accept these rules - take five minutes to read them. Article 1 · Events The LIGHT ON TRI events for the 2027 season are: LIGHT ON TRI Woippy**: Sunday 16 May 2027. LIGHT ON TRI Pierre-Percée***: Saturday 12 and Sunday 13 June 2027. LIGHT ON TRI Madine***: Saturday 18 and Sunday 19 September 2027. The Madine*** date was communicated directly by the organiser; the rules published on 07/10/2026 still listed "date to be announced" for this event at the time of writing. Article 2 · Briefing and distances A written briefing will be sent by email a few days before the event. Wearing a wetsuit is mandatory if the water temperature is not above 16°C. We recommend wearing one to take part in our events regardless. The athlete must wear the swim cap provided by the organiser. The timing chip must be worn around the left ankle during the event and returned after crossing the finish line. Any chip not returned will incur a €50 charge. A sticker must be attached to the helmet and to the bike's seat post. The bib provided must not be cut down or altered. It may be worn on a race-belt fixed at three points. Only one bib is issued per participant. No outside feeding is permitted other than that provided by the organiser. All athletes must respect the environment at all times, under penalty of immediate sanction. The formats offered vary by event, as follows: S* distance: approximately 0.5 km swim - 20 to 25 km bike - 5 km run. M** distance: approximately 1.5 km swim - 40 to 45 km bike - 10 km run. L*** distance: approximately 1.9 km swim - 85 to 90 km bike - 21 km run. Mini-Kids and Kids duathlons. Standalone run, depending on the event. The XS distance announced for Pierre-Percée*** in the rules published on 07/10/2026 is ultimately not being offered - confirmed directly by the organiser. Article 3 · Categories S* Triathlon: from the Cadet category upwards (born 2011 or earlier). M** Triathlon: from the Junior category upwards (born 2009 or earlier). L*** Triathlon: from the Junior category upwards (born 2009 or earlier). Mini-Kids: born 2018, 2019, 2020 or 2021. Kids: born 2014, 2015, 2016 or 2017. 6 or 7 km run: depending on conditions specific to the event. Age categories and eligibility conditions remain subject to the applicable federation regulations in 2027. Article 4 · Registration Registration is online only, at www.lightontri.com. L*** Triathlon: €119 (licence holder) / €134 (non-licence holder). M** Triathlon: €59 (licence holder) / €69 (non-licence holder). S* Triathlon: €34 (licence holder) / €39 (non-licence holder). Kids: €10. Licence holders must upload their triathlon licence on the registration platform. Non-licence holders must upload a medical certificate of no contraindication to competitive triathlon (or sport), less than a year old, on the registration platform at least 15 days before the event. The prices, competition passes and supporting documents applicable are those shown on the event's registration platform on the day of registration. Article 5 · Bib collection Bib collection takes place the day before each race from 17:00 to 19:00, or on race day, depending on the event's schedule. Photo ID is required to collect a bib. Article 6 · Schedule LIGHT ON TRI Pierre-Percée*** - Friday 11 June 2027 17:00 - 19:00: bib collection for Mini-Kids, Kids, S, M and L. Saturday 12 June 2027 7:30 - 9:00: L bib collection. 9:30: L Triathlon - women's and men's start. 10:00 - 10:45: Mini-Kids and Kids (duathlon) bib collection. 11:00: Mini-Kids Duathlon (born 2018, 2019, 2020 and 2021). 11:30: Kids Duathlon (born 2014, 2015, 2016 and 2017). 17:00 - 19:00: S and M bib collection. Sunday 13 June 2027 7:00 - 8:30: S bib collection. 9:00: S Triathlon - women's and men's start. 11:30 - 13:00: M bib collection. 13:30: M Triathlon - women's and men's start. The organiser reserves the right to change the schedule for the smooth running of the event. Format** - generic schedule 17:00 - 19:00: S and M bib collection (day before). 7:00 - 8:30: S bib collection. 8:00: S bike park opens. 8:45: S bike park closes. 9:00: S Triathlon - start. 11:00: S prize ceremony. 11:30 - 13:00: M bib collection. 12:30: M bike park opens. 13:15: M bike park closes. 13:30: M Triathlon - start. 17:00: M prize ceremony. LIGHT ON TRI Pierre-Percée*** The swim start is on the beach: L*** Triathlon, 2 laps of 950 metres (Australian exit); M** Triathlon, 2 laps of 750 metres (Australian exit); S* Triathlon, 1 lap of 500 metres. LIGHT ON TRI Madine*** The bike course starts from the bike park at the Lake Madine site (Nonsard-Lamarche side): L*** Triathlon, 2 laps; M** Triathlon, 1 lap; S* Triathlon, 1 lap. The organiser reserves the right to change the courses. Article 9 · Run LIGHT ON TRI Woippy** The run course starts from the bike park at the Woippy Plage site: S* Triathlon, 2 laps; M** Triathlon, 3 laps. LIGHT ON TRI Pierre-Percée*** The run course starts from the bike park at the Pierre-Percée site. M Triathlon: top 3 men / top 3 women; top 3 male veterans / top 3 female veterans. S Triathlon: top 3 men / top 3 women. L - 1st: €200 (men) / €200 (women). 2nd: €150 / €150. 3rd: €100 / €100. 4th and 5th: free entry for the N+1 edition. M - 1st: €100 (men) / €100 (women). 2nd: €75 / €75. 3rd: €50 / €50. 4th and 5th: free entry for the N+1 edition. No prizes on the S formats. Article 11 · Image rights Each athlete authorises LIGHT ON TRI's organisation to use images in which they may be identifiable, for promotional and advertising purposes. In accordance with the French Data Protection Act of 6 January 1978 and applicable regulations, each participant has a right of access to and rectification of their personal data. Article 12 · Insurance and liability LIGHT ON TRI is covered by SMACL Assurances under policy no. C2020-3654. The organisers cannot be held liable for theft, loss or accidents resulting from poor health or non-compliance with the rules. The organiser accepts no liability for health risks incurred by a participant as a result of taking part in the event. The participant acknowledges that taking part carries serious risks, including the risk of death, and that they are solely responsible for ensuring their state of health allows them to take part. The participant consents to receiving any necessary medical care and treatment during the competition. Treatment costs are not included in the registration fee. It is the participant's responsibility to take out any insurance necessary or useful for this purpose. The participant is solely responsible for their personal belongings and sporting equipment. The participant acknowledges that they may encounter vehicles or pedestrians on the course and accepts the risks associated with these circumstances. Risks include, among others, falls, collisions, technical incidents, equipment failure, inadequate protection, and risks related to ground conditions, spectators, volunteers or weather. The participant agrees to familiarise themselves with the course and transition areas before the event. Taking part constitutes acceptance of the course and transition areas as set. For insurance reasons, the bib is personal and non-transferable outside the transfer procedure set out in Article 15. Anyone taking part under a third party's bib without a proper transfer will not be covered by any insurance in the event of an accident. Article 13 · Cancellations and refunds On presentation of a medical certificate, the organiser will refund 50% of the registration fee, excluding fees charged by the registration platform, up to one month before the event. The amount of any day insurance will be refunded in full. No refund will be given for any other reason for withdrawal. No refund is possible within the month preceding the event. Registration transfer remains possible under the conditions of Article 15. In the event of cancellation for a cause not attributable to the organiser - including natural disaster, force majeure, security requirements, weather conditions or administrative decision - no registration can be refunded and no damages can be claimed from the organiser. Article 14 · Cancellation pack L*** Triathlon: €15. M** Triathlon: €10. The cancellation pack allows for a full refund of the registration fee up to three months before the event, then 50% of the amount from three months to one month before the event, less the cost of the pack and excluding platform fees. No refund is possible within the month preceding the event. For non-licence holders, the day insurance is refunded in full. No cancellation pack is offered on the S formats. Article 15 · Bib transfer A bib transfer is possible up to 48 hours before the event's first bib collection slot, at a cost of €3. The original holder must go to their runner area, select "transfer my registration" and enter the new participant's email address. The new participant must then complete a new registration with payment. The original holder will be refunded within eight days to the account linked to the card used for payment. Bibs are not transferable to the following year. The organiser cannot carry out this transfer on behalf of the participant. Article 16 · Time limits after the start L*** Triathlon: swim cut-off at 1h10; bike cut-off at 5h30. M** Triathlon: bike cut-off at 3h00. S* Triathlon: no time limit.
